objectives_fil: Ihambing ang card sa kasalukuyang aprubadong iskedyul, kumpirmahin ang hindi malinaw na tala, at ayusin ang follow-up sa health team.
Tingnan ang kasalukuyang lokal na programa at eligibility, ipaliwanag ang makukumpirma pa lamang, at iugnay siya sa provider.
objectives_en: Given a fictional child card and the current approved schedule, identify a due/missed visit and counsel the caregiver.
Given an adult concern, identify which current local vaccine program to ask about and where to refer.
summary_fil: Magpabakuna: 2 aralin na may kaso, pagsasanay at observer sheet.
summary_en: Priority area 3: Get Vaccinated: 2 lessons with cases, practice and observer sheets.
